test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
(1) She logged into the portal.
(2) Her connection dropped.
(3) The exam had already begun.
(4) She contacted support immediately.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
